on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      flutter: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.flutter }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Filter by paths
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v4
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            flutter:
              - '**/android/**'
              - '**/assets/**'
              - '**/dart_defines/**'
              - '**/golden_test/**'
              - '**/ios/**'
              - '**/lib/**'
              - '**/test/**'
              - '**/web/**'
              - '**/analysis_options.yaml'
              - '**/melos.yaml'
              - '**/pubspec.yaml'
              - '.fvmrc'

  analyze:
    needs: check
    if: ${{ needs.check.outputs.flutter == 'true' && github.event_name != 'push' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Flutter with FVM
        id: setup-flutter
        uses: kuhnroyal/flutter-fvm-config-action/setup@v3

      - name: Cache Flutter and pub dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-flutter-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml', '**/pubspec.lock', '.fvmrc') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-flutter-

      - name: Prepare Melos
        run: echo "MELOS_SDK_PATH=${{ env.FLUTTER_ROOT }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install Melos
        uses: bluefireteam/melos-action@v3
        with:
          run-bootstrap: true

      - name: Analyze packages
        run: flutter analyze --fatal-infos

      - name: Check for the existence of unformatted files
        # Cannot use `melos format` as it requires excluding files generated from the target file
        run: melos run format:ci --no-select

  test:
    needs: check
    if: needs.check.outputs.flutter == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Flutter with FVM
        id: setup-flutter
        uses: kuhnroyal/flutter-fvm-config-action/setup@v3

        uses: actions/cache@v4

          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-flutter-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml', '**/pubspec.lock', '.fvmrc') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-flutter-

      - name: Prepare Melos
        run: echo "MELOS_SDK_PATH=${{ env.FLUTTER_ROOT }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install Melos
        uses: bluefireteam/melos-action@v3
        with:
          run-bootstrap: true

      - name: Run package tests
        run: melos run test:ci --no-select

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage/lcov.info",

The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) is supported by evidence and its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable across the two jobs, and cache inputs include the lockfile and environment (pubspec.yaml, pubspec.lock, and .fvmrc are already tracked in the path filter).
